Interface PropertyManagerViewInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
PropertyManagerView
public interface PropertyManagerViewInterface
PropertyManagerViewInterface defines the methods for the Property Manager GUI, including navigation, interaction, data retrieval, and button access. The interface helps in separating the view's implementation from its usage in the controller.
